scoped_buttons = {','.join(map(str, node.element_info.runtime_id)) for node in children
                      if node.element_info.control_type == 'Button'}
    close = [e['id'] for e in state['elements'] if e['id'] in scoped_buttons and e.get('enabled')
             and e.get('kind') == 'click' and not e.get('clipped') and not e.get('requires_confirmation')
             and re.fullmatch(r'(?:(?:메뉴|상품)\s*)?(?:옵션\s*)?닫기|close(?:\s+(?:options|dialog))?', e['name'], re.I)]
    if len(close) == 1:
        state['draft_dismiss_id'] = close[0]
